name: Molten carbonate fuel cell capture
principle: Flue gas passes over the cathode of a carbonate fuel cell. CO2 migrates through the electrolyte to the anode side, where it is concentrated and condensed from the anode exhaust, while the cell generates power. FuelCell Energy and ExxonMobil have worked on the design since 2016 and ExxonMobil is building a pilot at its Rotterdam complex.

process_steps.name: Anode exhaust chilling and CO2 liquefaction
